name: molpha-mcp
description: Lets AI agents fetch signed Molpha oracle data, publish it on Solana, and build verifier calldata.
long_description:
Molpha turns HTTP API responses into threshold-signed payloads that can be verified on Solana, EVM, and Starknet.

This extension exposes that workflow as MCP tools and keeps signing behind a local keypair, Privy, or Turnkey-backed wallet.

**Current release targets Solana Devnet and Sepolia verifier networks.** Treat it as testnet software. Write tools spend SOL, and round tools may consume subscription quota or pay USDC for x402 rounds, unless dry-run mode is enabled.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Return the program id, registry version, node set, gateways, chains, verifier metadata, and the round tool for each payment path.

tools.name: derive_source_id
tools.description: Validate a source document and derive its sourceId locally: keccak256 of its canonical JSON (a JCS subset, sorted keys, numbers as strings). Returns the canonical JSON, the declared output and determinism warnings. No transaction or wallet.

tools.name: describe_feed
tools.description: Read the Solana feed for (sourceId, quorum, submitter) and the signer's subscription status. Pass the source to read the stored value by its declared output.

tools.name: get_latest_value
tools.description: Read the latest attested value stored in a Solana feed account; with the source, rendered by its declared output (type and decimals).

tools.name: describe_access
tools.description: Read from chain whether a wallet is a subscription owner or delegate, and its plan and round limits.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List the data providers the gateway integrates (for example TickerLayer) and the access flows it serves for each.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Describe one integrated provider: flows, required aggregation, disclosure, and ready-made feeds with a complete source document and sourceId.

tools.name: quote_source_payment
tools.description: Read a paywalled source's price with one unpaid request: price per fetch, the nodes that will fetch, the worst-case total, and whether this server would pay it.

tools.name: get_x402_status
tools.description: Quote the next x402 round and read where payment goes, a payer's USDC balance (the signer's by default), and the remaining daily x402 budget.

tools.name: execute_subscription_round
tools.description: Run a subscription-paid signing round and return the signed attestation plus verifier arguments. autoSubmit settles the Solana leg in the same call.

tools.name: execute_x402_round
tools.description: Run an x402 pay-per-request signing round and return the signed attestation plus verifier arguments. autoSubmit settles the Solana leg in the same call.

tools.name: build_verifier_calldata
tools.description: Build EVM/Starknet verifier address and verify() call arguments. Calldata only: it verifies nothing — the agent executes verify() itself.

tools.name: submit_attestation
tools.description: Submit a signed attestation to Solana. Accepts a round tool's output unmodified.

tools.name: list_data_templates
tools.description: List Molpha Data on-chain data templates (token supply, pool prices, LST rates, lending, health factors, oracle checks), their parameters and tools.

tools.name: read_data
tools.description: Read a Molpha Data template or raw source, unsigned: the service's own read with the source it read, re-hashed here. Signs nothing.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Account balance (account.balance@1): A wallet's native balance (EVM) or token balance (ERC-20, Starknet token, or the wallet's associated SPL token account). An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_chain_head
tools.description: Pinned block (chain.head@1): The block (EVM, Starknet) or slot (Solana) a source of this chain and finality reads at, from the source format's $block. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_curve_oracle_price
tools.description: Curve EMA price oracle (curve.priceOracle@1): A Curve pool's exponential moving average price (price_oracle) of coin i+1 in coin 0. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_pool_price
tools.description: Pool spot price (dex.pool.price@1): A concentrated-liquidity pool's current price from its square-root price, adjusted for both tokens' decimals. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_pool_reserve
tools.description: Pool reserve (dex.pool.reserves@1): One side of a pool's reserves: getReserves of a Uniswap v2-style pair, the token balance of a v3-style pool, or a Whirlpool's token vault. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_pool_snapshot
tools.description: Pool state snapshot (dex.pool.snapshot@1): A concentrated-liquidity pool's state under one signature: square-root price, tick, active liquidity and fee (Uniswap v3 family), or the Whirlpool account up to its fee growth. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_pool_twap
tools.description: Pool TWAP (mean tick) (dex.pool.twap@1): The arithmetic mean tick over a window, from the pool's own oracle (observe), rounded as Uniswap's OracleLibrary rounds. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_vault_share_price
tools.description: Vault share price (erc4626.sharePrice@1): Assets per vault share, from the vault's own convertToAssets. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_storage_slot
tools.description: Storage slot (evm.storage@1): The 32 bytes of one storage slot of a contract at the pinned block. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_aave_reserve
tools.description: Aave v3 reserve rate or index (lending.aave.reserve@1): One of an Aave v3 (or Spark) reserve's current rates or indexes, from Pool.getReserveData. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_aave_totals
tools.description: Aave v3 reserve totals (lending.aave.totals@1): An Aave v3 (or Spark) reserve's total supplied (aToken supply) or borrowed (variable debt token supply), or its utilization. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_morpho_market
tools.description: Morpho Blue market totals (lending.morpho.market@1): A Morpho Blue market's total supplied or borrowed assets, or its utilization, from market(id). An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_lst_rate
tools.description: Liquid staking token exchange rate (lst.rate@1): How much of the base asset one liquid staking token is worth, read from the token's own contract or stake pool. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: compare_oracles
tools.description: Two oracle prices compared (oracle.compare@1): The deviation between two price feeds on one chain (Chainlink aggregators or Pyth price feeds), refusing a feed older than maxAge; or whether they agree within a bound. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_aave_health_factor
tools.description: Aave v3 health factor (position.aave.health@1): An account's health factor on an Aave v3 (or Spark) market, from Pool.getUserAccountData. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_aave_liquidation_distance
tools.description: Aave v3 distance to liquidation (position.aave.liquidationDistance@1): How far an account's collateral value can fall, debt unchanged, before the position can be liquidated: 1 - 1/healthFactor. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_morpho_health_factor
tools.description: Morpho Blue health factor (position.morpho.health@1): A borrower's health on a Morpho Blue market, computed as Morpho computes it: collateral at the market's oracle price times LLTV, over the borrow assets of the borrower's shares. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_median_price
tools.description: Median price across pools (price.median@1): The median price of a token in a quote token across two to four concentrated-liquidity pools of that pair, optionally refusing pools below a liquidity floor. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: reconcile_supply
tools.description: Bridged supply against its lockbox (supply.reconcile@1): A canonical token's balance locked in a bridge, less the total supply of its bridged copies on up to three other chains. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_token_snapshot
tools.description: Token snapshot (token.snapshot@1): A token's supply and decimals (EVM, Starknet) or its whole SPL mint (supply, decimals, mint and freeze authorities) under one signature. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: get_token_supply
tools.description: Token total supply (token.supply@1): The total supply of a token, in whole tokens, read from the token contract or the SPL mint. An unsigned read with its source; execute_data_round signs it.

tools.name: execute_data_round
tools.description: Run a Molpha Data template (or raw source) as a threshold-signed round through execute_subscription_round or execute_x402_round, with their dry-run lock and spend caps.

signer_backend.title: Signer backend
signer_backend.description: memory (local keypair), keychain (Privy / Turnkey), or none. Leave empty with no keypair for a read-only server that cannot sign or spend.

owner_keypair.title: Owner keypair
owner_keypair.description: Solana JSON keypair file. Required when signer backend is memory.

keychain_backend.title: Keychain backend
keychain_backend.description: privy or turnkey. Required when signer backend is keychain.

privy_wallet_address.title: Privy wallet address
privy_wallet_address.description: Solana address for the Privy wallet.

turnkey_wallet_address.title: Turnkey wallet address
turnkey_wallet_address.description: Solana address for the Turnkey wallet.

gateway_endpoints.title: Gateway endpoints
gateway_endpoints.description: Comma-separated Molpha gateway URLs. Leave empty to use the SDK default.

gateway_authorities.title: Gateway authorities
gateway_authorities.description: Comma-separated base58 gateway authorities, one per gateway endpoint in the same order. Required for gateways that do not serve GET /v1/info.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Preview all write and spend operations without submitting them. While on, a tool call cannot turn it off: to spend, untick this and restart.

x402_max_price_usdc.title: x402 max price (USDC)
x402_max_price_usdc.description: Refuse to pay for an x402 round priced above this amount (decimal USDC).

x402_max_spend_per_day_usdc.title: x402 max spend per day (USDC)
x402_max_spend_per_day_usdc.description: Process-local daily cap on USDC signed for x402 rounds (decimal USDC).

source_payer_key.title: Source payer key
source_payer_key.description: Hex private key of the EVM wallet that pays paywalled sources (for example a provider x402 feed). Never printed or returned by a tool. Source payment stays off without it and without allowed networks.

source_payment_networks.title: Source payment networks
source_payment_networks.description: Comma-separated CAIP-2 EVM networks a source may be paid on, e.g. eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia). Empty keeps source payment off, even with a payer key.

source_max_per_round_usdc.title: Source max per round (USDC)
source_max_per_round_usdc.description: Refuse a round whose worst case (price per fetch × the nodes that may fetch) exceeds this (decimal USDC).

source_max_spend_per_day_usdc.title: Source max spend per day (USDC)
source_max_spend_per_day_usdc.description: Process-local daily cap on USDC committed to paying sources (decimal USDC).
